newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nails in Paris bomb point to Algerian lead.
newsitem.headline: Nails in Paris bomb point to Algerian lead.

text.p: Investigators have found evidence that the bomb which killed two people at a Paris train station on Tuesday contained nails, a technique used by Algerian Moslem fundamentalists in bombings last year, French radio said.
Europe-1 radio said that police had found part of the bomb on a regional express train and that the body of one of the victims had been mutilated by nails.
"This carries the signature of the Algerian (fundamentalists) and of their network in France," the radio quoted one police officer as saying.

It said that police were questioning eight witnesses including the driver of the train targeted during the early evening rush hour at Port Royal station on the Left Bank. Twenty-eight people were injured.

No one claimed responsibility, but the target, the timing and the type of bomb bore all the hallmarks of attacks in the capital last year by Moslem fundamentalists fighting against Algeria's French-backed military rulers.
